_comment: Golden prompts for scripts/eval.py --agent methane. expected_tools is a SUBSEQUENCE of the streamed tool calls; forbidden_text must not appear. reverse_geocode (ArcGIS MCP) is never expected: the gate must not fail on a third-party outage. Permian Basin 2024 = 39 plume complexes in EMITL2BCH4PLM.002; their GeoTIFFs are cached in s3://<bucket>/methane/cache/ after the first triage. "operations" / " leak" are forbidden everywhere: the agent describes, it does not attribute. closer_max_chars: the spoken closing paragraph must fit the 280-character caption band. closer_endswith: the last paragraph (the spoken closer) must end with the short confidence line. setup_prompt: an unchecked first turn in the same session, so the presenter's follow-up wording is tested; closer_forbidden: the spoken closer names the place, never coordinates (°N/°W). Methane Watch (Req 8-12): the mission prompt must plan first ("Plan:"), name the plume-product gap, call every watch tool (required_tools: any order, they run in parallel), draft (never file) a brief with unconfirmed hypotheses, and end with "Decision: analyst's." before the closer. Provocations must name no operator, government or intent; the operator list is a tripwire, not an allowlist.
